title: Exactness of a short complex of abelian sheaves is detected on stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $S=(A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C)$, $g\circ f=0$, be a short complex of sheaves of abelian groups on $X$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], with stalks and stalk maps as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then $S$ is exact (at $B$) if and only if, for every $x\in X$, the short complex of abelian groups $A_x\xrightarrow{f_x}B_x\xrightarrow{g_x}C_x$ is exact.

source.place: Sheaves, Section 007S (exactness at points), together with Mathlib Topology/Sheaves/Abelian.lean theorem exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact
